dct_description_sm: A map of York County compiled and published by the Map Specialty Co. in 1908. Map marks the locations of large cities as well as smaller villages and hamlets.In addition to roads, railways and even power lines are shown on this map. The print version of this map was originally drawn at a scale of 100 chains to 1 inch (a chain is a unit of measurement approximately equal to 20m). Different colours are used to differentiate between different municipalities.
